title: Noradrenaline and serotonin-dependent sensitization of MSCs to noradrenaline
author: Chechekhin, Kulebyakin, et al.

steps.title: Prepare dye stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make 1000× dye stocks (4 mM) of Fluo‑8 or Fura‑2, aliquot, store at –20 °C and avoid freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Seed MSCs at low density
steps.instruction: One day before the experiment seed MSCs in a 24‑well or 48‑well plate at a final density of ~10–20 % of a confluent monolayer, distributing cells evenly and avoiding plate rotation that would concentrate cells in the well centre.

steps.title: Pre‑incubate with hormone or vehicle
steps.instruction: Prepare 10× hormone solutions in culture medium: 10 µM noradrenaline or 100 µM 5‑HT. For vehicle use the same volume of water. Add the 10× solution directly to the wells to achieve the final concentrations (1 µM noradrenaline, 10 µM 5‑HT) and incubate for 1 h, mixing gently by slowly rotating the plate without touching the surface.

steps.title: Wash cells carefully
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with Hanks Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS). During each wash leave a 2–3 mm liquid layer above the cells, add fresh HBSS smoothly, then aspirate leaving the same liquid layer, and repeat. If hormone removal is required, repeat the wash 6–7 times and finish with two washes of complete growth medium.

steps.title: Incubate in full growth medium
steps.instruction: Replace HBSS with complete growth medium and incubate the cells for an additional 5 h.

steps.title: Prepare dye staining solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the 1000× dye stock in HBSS containing 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.2 to a working concentration of 4 µM (for either Fura‑2 or Fluo‑8).

steps.title: Remove medium and wash before staining
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with an excess volume of HBSS + 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.2 to remove the growth medium.

steps.title: Stain cells with calcium dye
steps.instruction: Add the 4 µM dye solution to the cells and incubate for 1 h in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator. Do not add pluronic, as it interferes with MSC calcium signaling.

steps.title: Wash off excess dye
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with HBSS + 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.2 to remove unincorporated dye.

steps.title: Set up fluorescence microscope
steps.instruction: Configure the inverted microscope: for Fluo‑8 use a GFP/FITC filter set; for Fura‑2 use a light source capable of rapid switching between 340 nm and 380 nm excitation with appropriate multiband filters. Reduce phototoxicity by setting the camera to maximum sensitivity, using the lowest light intensity possible, and optionally applying pixel binning.

steps.title: Define time‑lapse acquisition parameters
steps.instruction: Set image acquisition intervals to 20–30 s (no larger intervals) and, if possible, enable multi‑position mode to record hormone‑treated and vehicle‑treated wells simultaneously.

steps.title: Record basal calcium activity
steps.instruction: Start time‑lapse recording and capture basal MSC activity for 5–10 min before any stimulus.

steps.title: Add noradrenaline during recording
steps.instruction: Prepare a noradrenaline solution in HBSS + 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.2 at 2 µM (2×). Add an equal volume of this solution directly to each well while recording; the final concentration becomes 1 µM. No mixing is required after addition.

steps.title: Analyze responding cells
steps.instruction: Count the number of individual cells that show a calcium response to noradrenaline, normalize to the total cell number in the field, and repeat the experiment in at least 5–8 independent wells per treatment condition.
